title: West End Transit Plaza
subtitle: Studio — transit and public realm
summary: A transit plaza for Cincinnati’s West End: a folded canopy over the bus bays between Oliver Street and West Liberty Street, beside Laurel Playground, with a planted plaza that makes waiting a comfortable civic moment. Site plan and street-level perspectives by Matthew Reindl.
